geometry.preprocessor: Existing CR1 Encoder unchanged: mean-mask, aspect-preserving square padding, bilinear antialiased 224×224, 16×16 tokens, ImageNet normalization.
geometry.full_local: Same ROI/canvas/native geometry; local preserves only the existing 25×25 anchor footprint, full retains visible ROI context. No recropping or scale retry.
geometry.reference: All 25×25 approved pixels required visible. Unit bilinearly sampled mean over 625 pixel centres; full/local references kept separately.
geometry.query: All existing visible central-column Canny rows; existing scale/origin preserved, including nine reduced controls. Original RGB absent on three saved sample4 rows/cases is UNAVAILABLE, never restored by gray replication or fresh decode.
geometry.sides: Fixed offsets X=-12..12; upper Y=-12..-2, lower Y=2..12, 275 pixels each. Every required native/working pixel visible, otherwise UNAVAILABLE. No support-dependent width.
geometry.weights: Reuse dimension-aware transfer.weights and strips; save complete weights, overlap mass and native/working pixels per token. Shared/remote token context means a region vector is not a pure material sample.
geometry.controls: Existing encoder-through-pixel remote-context control; six constructed fine/fine, large/large, fine/large, large/fine, blank/fine, fine/blank pixel contexts. Side-vector exchange reverses signed contrast and preserves mean; do not assume transformer reflection equivariance. Constructed pixels are not scene labels.

evaluation_only.guide_rule: Exact source coordinate joins only; no nearest-edge snapping, no per-path/candidate truth from scalar proximity. Original regional/internal guides retained with missing edges explicit.
evaluation_only.f1485: A/B physical positives withdrawn; query edges unreviewed. B practical acceptance does not label a centre Canny edge.
evaluation_only.unavailable_upper: Beer cropped upper and milk unclear lower keep original regional scope; all scheduled rows remain unreviewed.
evaluation_only.exposure: R/public scene and L/water A plus neighbours are initialization/reference exposure. Water B/C same-source opposition; sample4/beer/milk exposed development, not untouched holdout.
evaluation_only.real_internal_transitions: NOT_QUALIFIED: only constructed fine/large controls, not actual per-side labels.

stop: One fixed readout; stop on pin/geometry/control/resource failure. Preserve all rows and missing reasons. No score-guided reference/geometry/crop/scale/margin changes or successor efficacy claim.
retention: Keep frozen executable/preflight and full compact scores; reuse all input images and single environment; discard dense features and temporary copies.

geometric_readiness.appearance_coverage: Only approved reference footprints have grain-appearance labels; query appearance coverage/generalization remains NOT_EVALUATED.
